repair_findings_addressed.change: Activation updates now require exact generation equality; future-generation events cannot bypass CAS.

repair_findings_addressed.finding: S3 same-source ingress and resource bounds
repair_findings_addressed.change: Agent probe ingress parses and authenticates the frame before demultiplexing, bounds source-matching goroutines, caps replay entries, checks expiry with the injected clock, and writes ACK/RCT with bounded I/O. Controller provider replay cache is also TTL-swept and size-bounded.
Added the frozen top-level deletion polling route, durable forward-create replay/conflict handling with request hash and principal, and corrected runtime-status error selection.
Agent now polls route capability, tears down listeners and marks activation evidence stale on loss, retries durable recovery after restoration, and uses one process-global PortRegistry.
antinat-probe now loads the exact configured 0600 ANKC key file instead of silently loading a directory default; added format/mode/configured-path regression coverage.
probe_result now checks node ownership, frozen terminal outcome values, terminal immutability, provider probe-id binding, HTTP status, and result timestamp bounds.

The full repository suite requires ANTINAT_DEDICATED_UID/GID=12001; running without those variables fails the sandbox helper gate.
